scope: Bounded audit of released source metadata and two screenshots; no location or clock inferred from acoustic fit

audio_documentary_link.basis: Method-video description explicitly links raw-audio video 4CxVxuMVkMc; both descriptive metadata records name colsto.

recording_start_utc.source_statement: Transcript at 00:27 says September 8 in the continental US; no year/timezone or sample-zero UTC is supplied by that statement.
recording_start_utc.known_minute_statement: Transcript at 23:06 proposes 20:37 UTC for a one-minute example, without a verified raw-sample interval or uncertainty.
recording_start_utc.metadata_limit: Raw-audio metadata has an empty description, duration 3600 seconds, and upload/extraction times; these are not capture times.
recording_start_utc.plot_limit: source-1441.png shows horizontal-axis ticks 4860 through 4900; their offset to the 3600-second raw-audio timeline is not established by this frame.

microphone_position.source_statement: Transcript at 26:03-26:05 claims visual identification of the security camera after an audio-guided search.
microphone_position.image_limit: true_camera.png shows a Street View pole/harbor scene and map context, but the camera/microphone, recorder coordinates and uncertainty bounds are not established by that frame.
microphone_position.public_platform_limit: OspreyWatch nest3916 is the historical rounded platform reference; no supplied metadata identifies it as the recorder.
microphone_position.camera_lead_limit: Official PSEG/OspreyWatch nest12532 pages document a public webcam, but these source files do not link that stream to the reference audio.

findings.configured_regional_scope: Source-informed regional replay compared with the rounded public-platform listing; not independent automatic real accuracy.
minimum_remaining_evidence: A source record tying the preserved audio to an identified recorder/stream and its position region.
An independent recording date and sample-zero UTC interval, including clipping/stream-gap/offset uncertainty.
A supported automatic result under the declared search coverage and unchanged scientific gates.
findings.corpus_size_requirement: One qualifying real result can establish a first demonstration; a 12-recording corpus is a separate generalization program.

prohibited_inferences_not_made: No microphone coordinate or error radius inferred from candidate agreement or rounded coordinate precision.
No recording clock inferred from upload time, extraction time, Street View date, plot ticks, or the fitted clock.
No public webcam identity substituted for an undocumented source recorder.
